The whole final nūn belongs to man, not to min; the kasrah on it (-i) is a liaison (waṣl) vowel added to keep two unvowelled consonants (sukūns) from meeting before the next word. Read together: mimmani, 'than/from the one who'.

15.meaning: 'He fabricated, invented, forged (a lie); he concocted falsely' — made something up and falsely attributed it, especially a lie. A verb of deliberate fabrication.

parts.en: connecting (helping) vowel for the verb pattern
past-tense 3rd person masculine singular ending '-ā' (from a weak final root letter)

15.grammar: A past-tense verb, 3rd person masculine singular ('he fabricated'). It is a Form VIII (ifta'ala) verb. The final '-ā' (written as alif maqṣūra) is how the past-tense '-a' ending appears when the root ends in a weak letter (w/y). The initial 'i-' is a helping vowel that lets the consonant cluster of this pattern be pronounced.
15.root: ف-ر-ي (f-r-y) — to fabricate, forge, invent (a falsehood)

16.meaning: 'To / before / upon' — a preposition whose core sense is being on top of, above, or directed onto something; with a verb of presenting it carries the directional sense 'to / before / in front of,' and it can also convey obligation ('incumbent upon').
16.grammar: A preposition. Its basic meaning is 'on, upon, over,' but with verbs of displaying or presenting it shades into 'to / before / in front of.' It governs the following noun in the genitive case. It is fixed in form and takes no changing ending of its own (its final long -ā is an unchanging part of the word).
16.root: — (preposition; loosely related to the sense of 'height/elevation')

17.meaning: The proper name of the One God in Arabic: 'Allah' — the unique, absolute Deity, the sole object of worship, beside whom there is no other.
17.grammar: This is a proper name. The '-i' ending is the genitive case, the form a noun takes after a preposition or when linked to a preceding noun ('… of Allah', or 'besides Allah'). The leading 'al-' is fused into the name itself.

18.meaning: A noun meaning 'a lie / falsehood' — a deliberately false statement, an untruth fabricated against the truth.
18.grammar: An indefinite noun ('a lie') with the accusative -an ending (tanwīn). The accusative commonly marks the object of a verb (e.g. fabricating a lie); the -an tanwīn shows it is indefinite.
18.root: ك-ذ-ب (k-dh-b) — to lie, to declare false

1.meaning: 'And when …'. It joins a clause and points to a past time or circumstance — 'and at the time when …', introducing the recollection of an event.
1.grammar: A connector wa ('and') plus the time-word idh ('when'), which introduces a past situation or event. Its final vowel is normally a silent stop (-idh); here it is voiced as -idhi only to ease pronunciation before a following consonant cluster (this shift carries no extra meaning).
1.root: — (no triliteral root; a particle of time)

2.meaning: A past-tense statement meaning 'you withdrew/separated yourselves from them' — the verb iʿtazala is to set oneself apart, keep aloof, and disengage from people or things.
2.grammar: A completed (past-tense) verb, form VIII (the infix -t- after the first root letter), which gives a reflexive sense of 'taking oneself away.' The -tum ending is the attached subject pronoun 'you' (a group of males), here lengthened to -tumū before the object; the final -hum is the object pronoun 'them.' So: 'you-withdrew-from-them.'
2.root: ع-ز-ل (ʿ-z-l) — to set apart, isolate, withdraw aside

3.meaning: A connective phrase meaning 'and what' or 'and that which'. It adds a further item and points to an unspecified thing or category.
3.grammar: The connector wa ('and') joined to mā ('what, that which'). Here mā functions as a relative/indefinite pronoun ('that which'); the same word can elsewhere serve as a negator. It is invariable and takes no case ending.

4.meaning: Means 'they worship / they serve in devotion' — a present-tense verb for the ongoing act of worship: humble service, obedience, and devotion directed to a deity.
4.grammar: A present/ongoing verb. The ya- prefix together with the -ūna ending means 'they (masculine plural) do …'. The full -ūna ending also marks the verb as a plain statement of fact (indicative), as opposed to a shortened form used after certain particles.

5.meaning: A particle of exception meaning 'except,' 'save,' or 'only.' It carves out something from a preceding general statement — most often a preceding negation — so that the excepted item alone is affirmed, giving the strong sense 'none … but' or 'nothing other than.'
5.grammar: An exceptive particle (originally a fusion of 'in' + 'lā'). It is invariable — it has no case ending and does not change form. It introduces the item being excepted from, or restricted within, the preceding statement.
5.root: — (particle)

6.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the sole divine Being worshipped, unique and without partner. It is a definite, unparalleled name, not a common noun for any 'god.'
6.grammar: A proper name. The final -a is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the direct object of a verb, or as the noun governed by certain particles. The name is inherently definite and does not take a separate 'al-'.

7.meaning: A command meaning 'then take shelter / betake yourselves (for refuge).' The verb awā is to repair to a place for shelter and lodging, to take oneself to a haven; with an opening connector 'then/so.'
7.grammar: A command (imperative) addressed to a group of males: 'take shelter!' The -ū is the plural-addressee ending of the command (the written alif after it is silent). The fa- prefix means 'then' or 'so,' often signalling what to do as a next step or consequence.
7.root: ا-و-ي (ʾ-w-y) — to take shelter, repair to a refuge, give/find lodging

8.meaning: 'To / toward / up to' — a preposition marking the endpoint, goal, or limit of an action or motion: the direction something moves toward or the boundary at which it stops.
8.grammar: An invariable preposition. It has no case ending of its own but puts the noun that follows it into the genitive ('of / to' state). It indicates direction toward, or the terminal limit of, something.

9.meaning: The cave — a hollow opening or cavern in a mountain or rock, large enough to give shelter.
9.grammar: A noun with the definite article 'al-' ('the'). The final -i is the genitive case — the form taken after a preposition or when joined to a preceding noun ('… OF …', e.g. 'companions OF the cave').
9.root: ك-ه-ف (k-h-f) — cave, cavern; a place of refuge

10.meaning: A present/future statement meaning 'he/it spreads out / unfolds / extends widely' — the verb nashara is to spread, unfurl, or disseminate something far and wide.
10.grammar: A present/future verb with the ya- prefix meaning 'he' or 'it' (masculine). The final consonant carries a silent (jussive) ending, the form a verb takes after certain particles such as conditional words or 'so that,' giving the sense of a contingent or requested action rather than a flat statement.
10.root: ن-ش-ر (n-sh-r) — to spread out, unfurl, scatter widely, disseminate

11.meaning: 'For you' or 'to you' — the preposition of benefit or attribution ('for / belonging to') combined with a plural 'you', marking the people for whose benefit or possession something is done.
11.grammar: A preposition with an attached pronoun. The prefix la- (the preposition li- 'for', here vowelled 'la' before a pronoun) conveys benefit, purpose, or belonging. The suffix -kum is the second-person masculine plural object, 'you all'.

12.meaning: Your (plural) Lord — 'Rabb' means the Master, Owner, Sustainer, and Nurturer who creates, provides for, and brings a thing to its completion. It combines lordship with loving upbringing and care.
12.grammar: A noun with an attached possessive pronoun. The suffix '-kum' means 'your' (plural possessor). The '-u' on 'rabbu' before the suffix is the nominative case, marking the word as a subject or as a predicate standing on its own.
12.root: ر-ب-ب (r-b-b) — to nurture, master, sustain, own

13.meaning: A preposition whose core sense is 'from' — marking a starting point or origin (from a place, time, or source). It also commonly means 'of' or 'among' (part of a larger whole) and 'than' in comparisons.
13.grammar: A preposition. It is indeclinable and governs the following noun in the genitive case. Its primary force is point of origin ('starting from'), and it frequently expresses partitioning ('some of / part of').

14.meaning: Mercy, compassion, tender care that actively benefits its object — joined to 'His': His mercy.
14.grammar: A feminine noun joined to the attached pronoun -hi ('his / its'). The -i vowel on the stem is the genitive ending, which appears because the noun is linked to a following possessor or follows a preposition ('... of ...'); the -hi suffix names that possessor: 'His mercy.' The original feminine -t- sound surfaces because a suffix follows.

15.meaning: "and He will make ready / prepare" — to arrange and smooth out something so it is well-disposed and easy to obtain. The verb conveys preparing matters and facilitating them in a fitting way.
15.grammar: A present/future verb in the third-person masculine singular: the yu- prefix means "he," and the form (Form II, causative) carries the sense of actively arranging or readying. The bare ending (sukūn on the final root letter) reflects the jussive/apocopated mood, which generally appears after conditional particles or in linked clauses signalling "then he will…"
15.root: ه-ي-ء (h-y-ʾ) — to make ready, prepare, set in order

16.meaning: 'For you' or 'to you' — the preposition of benefit or attribution ('for / belonging to') combined with a plural 'you', marking the people for whose benefit or possession something is done.
16.grammar: A preposition with an attached pronoun. The prefix la- (the preposition li- 'for', here vowelled 'la' before a pronoun) conveys benefit, purpose, or belonging. The suffix -kum is the second-person masculine plural object, 'you all'.

17.meaning: A preposition whose core sense is 'from' — marking a starting point or origin (from a place, time, or source). It also commonly means 'of' or 'among' (part of a larger whole) and 'than' in comparisons.
17.grammar: A preposition. It is indeclinable and governs the following noun in the genitive case. Its primary force is point of origin ('starting from'), and it frequently expresses partitioning ('some of / part of').

18.meaning: "your affair / your matter" — a command, situation, or piece of business that concerns you. "Amr" denotes both a directive and an affair to be managed.
18.grammar: A noun carrying the -i (genitive) ending, which typically marks a word as the object of a preposition or as possessed ("… of …"). The attached -kum is a possessive pronoun meaning "your" addressed to a group (masculine plural).
18.root: ا-م-ر (ʾ-m-r) — to command; an affair or matter

19.meaning: "ease, comfort, a helpful convenience" — that which makes a task gentle and manageable; relief and accommodation that smooths one's circumstances.
19.grammar: A noun with the -an ending: this "tanwīn" of -a marks the indefinite accusative ("a/an …"), commonly used for the direct object of a verb or for a specifying complement (answering "in what respect?").
19.root: ر-ف-ق (r-f-q) — gentleness, kindness, helpful accompaniment

1.meaning: "and you see / would see" — to perceive with the eyes or to behold; also "to regard" something as being a certain way.
1.grammar: A present-tense verb in the second-person masculine singular: the ta- prefix means "you (one man)." This verb comes from a weak root, so its final weak letter shows as the long -ā vowel; in the indicative it expresses ongoing or potential seeing.

2.meaning: The sun — the blazing daytime luminary.
2.grammar: A feminine noun with the definite article al- ('the'). The final -a is the accusative ending, which generally marks the noun as the direct object of a verb (the thing acted upon) or the subject of certain particles.
2.root: ش-م-س (sh-m-s) — the sun, sunshine

3.meaning: 'When' — a particle introducing a time or circumstance, generally pointing to something expected or definite to come ('when/whenever it happens'). It sets up a condition or moment whose outcome then follows.
3.grammar: An indeclinable adverb/particle of time; it has no case ending and never changes form. It typically introduces a clause about a future or recurring event ('when …'), and is normally followed by a verb describing what takes place.

4.meaning: "it rose" — said of the sun coming up and appearing; more broadly, to ascend into view or emerge.
4.grammar: A past-tense verb. The -at ending (here written -t with a quiescent ending) marks the third-person feminine singular, "she/it (did)," used for feminine nouns such as "the sun."
4.root: ط-ل-ع (ṭ-l-ʿ) — to rise, come up, emerge into view

5.meaning: "it inclines / leans away, swerves aside" — to tilt or turn away from something, slanting off to one side.
5.grammar: A present-tense verb, third-person feminine singular (the ta- prefix here means "she/it"). It comes from a reflexive/mutual pattern conveying a turning or veering of oneself; the final -u vowel marks the indicative mood (a plain, ongoing statement).
5.root: ز-و-ر (z-w-r) — to turn aside, deviate, incline away

6.meaning: A preposition meaning 'on behalf of,' 'for,' 'about,' or 'away from.' It often conveys removing a burden from someone or acting in their place.

parts.en: on behalf of / for / away from

6.grammar: A preposition (a linking particle). It governs the noun that follows it, putting that noun into the genitive case. It does not change form.

7.meaning: "their cave" — a hollow or cavern in a mountain large enough to shelter people.
7.grammar: A noun with the -i (genitive) ending, marking it as possessed or as following a preposition ("… of …"). The attached -him is a possessive pronoun, "their," referring to a group of males.
7.root: ك-ه-ف (k-h-f) — a cave, cavern, mountain hollow

8.meaning: Possessor of, the one having, or the feminine 'that which has'. A feminine word meaning 'owner of' or 'characterized by', used to attach a quality or relationship to something (e.g. 'that which is between', i.e. the state of mutual relations).
8.grammar: A feminine noun of relation meaning 'possessor/owner of', placed before another noun to ascribe it. The -a ending is accusative: it commonly marks the object of a verb or otherwise the noun governed within the sentence.
8.root: — (functions as a noun of possession; no standard triliteral root).

9.meaning: "the right (side/hand)" — the right-hand direction, often carrying overtones of strength, good fortune, and honor.
9.grammar: A definite noun ("the …" via al-) carrying the -i (genitive) ending, which typically marks it as following a preposition or as linked to a preceding noun ("… of the right").
9.root: ي-م-ن (y-m-n) — the right side; good fortune, blessing

10.meaning: 'And when...' — a linking phrase joining 'and' to 'when', used to introduce a circumstance or a recurring situation: 'and whenever / and at the time that...'.
10.grammar: The connector wa- ('and') attached to idhā ('when'). Idhā is a particle pointing to a time or condition, generally referring to something expected or recurring in the future ('when / whenever' it happens), and it normally introduces a following clause that states what occurs at that time.

11.meaning: "it set" — said of the sun going down and disappearing below the horizon; to sink out of sight in the west.
11.grammar: A past-tense verb. The -at ending (written -t with a quiescent ending) marks the third-person feminine singular, "she/it (did)," used for feminine nouns such as "the sun."
11.root: غ-ر-ب (gh-r-b) — to set (of the sun); the west; to depart, go far

12.meaning: "it passes them by / turns away from them, cutting clear of them" — to swerve past and leave them to one side, giving them a wide berth.
12.grammar: A present-tense verb, third-person feminine singular: the ta- prefix means "she/it." The final -u vowel marks the indicative mood (a plain, ongoing statement). The attached -hum is an object pronoun, "them," referring to a group of males.
12.root: ق-ر-ض (q-r-ḍ) — to cut, sever; to pass by leaving aside

13.meaning: Possessor of, the one having, or the feminine 'that which has'. A feminine word meaning 'owner of' or 'characterized by', used to attach a quality or relationship to something (e.g. 'that which is between', i.e. the state of mutual relations).
13.grammar: A feminine noun of relation meaning 'possessor/owner of', placed before another noun to ascribe it. The -a ending is accusative: it commonly marks the object of a verb or otherwise the noun governed within the sentence.
13.root: — (functions as a noun of possession; no standard triliteral root).

14.meaning: "the left (side/hand)" — the left-hand direction; also "the north" in some usages.
14.grammar: A definite noun ("the …" via al-, here assimilated to the following sh-) with the -i (genitive) ending, which typically marks it as following a preposition or as linked to a preceding noun ("… of the left").
14.root: ش-م-ل (sh-m-l) — the left side; the north; to encompass

15.meaning: 'While they / and they' — the word 'wa' (here 'while' or 'and') joined to the standalone pronoun 'hum' ('they'), referring to a masculine plural group.
15.grammar: A connective 'wa' — often circumstantial 'while' — plus the independent subject pronoun 'hum' ('they'), used for a masculine plural group. As an independent pronoun it usually stands as the subject of a following statement.

16.meaning: A preposition meaning 'in,' 'within,' or 'inside.' It locates something inside a place, a time, a state, or a matter — physically or figuratively (e.g. 'in' a condition or 'concerning' a matter).
16.grammar: A preposition. It is invariable (it does not change form) and places the following noun into the genitive case, indicating containment or location 'in / within' something.
16.root: — (particle)

17.meaning: "an open space, a wide hollow" — a roomy, empty expanse, especially a spacious clearing within or among an enclosure.
17.grammar: A noun with the -in ending: this "tanwīn" of -i marks the indefinite genitive ("a/an …"), used when the word is indefinite and either follows a preposition or is linked to a preceding noun. The underlying tāʾ marbūṭa gives it feminine form.
17.root: ف-ج-و (f-j-w) — to be wide, open, spacious; a gap or expanse

18.meaning: A prepositional phrase, 'from him/it' — indicating origin or source, that something proceeds out of him/it.
18.grammar: The preposition min ('from') with the attached pronoun -hu ('him/it', third-person masculine singular). As the object of a preposition the pronoun stands in the genitive; the combination indicates source or origin.

19.meaning: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'that' — pointing to something regarded as distant or elevated, as opposed to 'this' (hadha) for what is near. It singles out a masculine singular thing and lends it a sense of distinction or loftiness.
19.grammar: A demonstrative for a masculine singular referent at a distance. The -ka ending is an address particle directed at a single male listener; it does not change for case. The whole word stays fixed in form regardless of its grammatical position.

20.meaning: 'From, out of': a preposition marking the starting point or source of something — the origin from which a thing comes, or a part taken from a whole.
20.grammar: A preposition expressing origin, source, or partition ('from, out of, some of'). A noun governed by min stands in the genitive relationship and would typically take an -i type ending. The particle itself is invariable.

21.meaning: Signs, tokens, or evident proofs; also used for the discrete verses of revelation. An āya is a marker that points beyond itself to a deeper truth or to its Author.
21.grammar: A feminine plural noun ('signs/verses'). The sound-feminine plural takes -i in both the genitive and accusative; the -i ending here links it to a following noun ('… of …') or marks it as the object of a verb or preposition.

22.meaning: The proper name of the One God in Arabic: 'Allah' — the unique, absolute Deity, the sole object of worship, beside whom there is no other.
22.grammar: This is a proper name. The '-i' ending is the genitive case, the form a noun takes after a preposition or when linked to a preceding noun ('… of Allah', or 'besides Allah'). The leading 'al-' is fused into the name itself.

23.meaning: A pronoun meaning 'who / whoever / the one who', used for people; it points to a person or persons without naming them and usually introduces a description of them.
23.grammar: An indeclinable pronoun (it never changes its ending) referring to a person or persons — 'who' or 'whoever'. It can ask a question ('who?') or, as a relative pronoun, link to a following clause that describes the person(s) it stands for.

24.meaning: He guides / is guided — to show the right way; depending on form it can mean 'he guides (someone)' or 'he is rightly guided.'
24.grammar: A present-tense verb in the jussive (apocopate) form: the weak final letter is dropped, leaving the bare -i as the trace of the jussive mood. The ya- prefix marks a single masculine doer ('he'), and the shortened form is the one a verb takes when governed by a jussive operator.
24.root: ه-د-ي (h-d-y) — to guide, show the way

25.meaning: The proper name Allah — the One True God, the unique and supreme Deity worshipped in Islam, without partner or equal. The name itself denotes the sole object of worship. Here it stands in the nominative case (as a subject or topic).
25.grammar: A proper noun (the divine name). Every letter of اللّٰه, including the final ه, is an integral consonant of the name; it is not built from separable affixes. Only the short vowel damma (-u) written over the final ه is a grammatical marker: it is the nominative case ending, the form a noun takes when it is the doer/subject of a verb or the topic of a sentence. So the damma marks Allah as the one performing the action or the subject being described, while the consonant ه remains part of the name itself.

26.meaning: A two-part phrase: the connector 'then / so' plus the standalone pronoun 'he / it,' used to point back and resume with 'then he…' or 'so it…'
26.grammar: The connector 'fa' ('then/so') plus the detached subject pronoun 'huwa' ('he/it'), 3rd-person masculine singular. Both are indeclinable, with no case ending; the pronoun typically begins or emphasizes a statement about 'he/it.'

27.meaning: "the rightly-guided one" — the person who has found and follows the true path; one led aright.
27.grammar: A definite active participle ("the one who …" via al-), built on a reflexive pattern (Form VIII) meaning "one who has accepted/found guidance for himself." It comes from a weak final-root letter (a defective participle), so the underlying yāʾ is dropped and the word ends in a shortened -i; this -i stands for the nominative/genitive ending, which on such defective nouns is reduced rather than fully pronounced. The form names the doer of the action — "the guided one."
27.root: ه-د-ي (h-d-y) — to guide, lead aright; guidance

28.meaning: And whoever / and the one who — a joining word plus a relative pronoun introducing a person (or persons) defined by whatever they do; often sets up a condition ('whoever does X …').
28.grammar: A particle 'and' joined to the relative/conditional pronoun man ('whoever, who'). Man does not change its ending; it refers to people and frequently functions as a conditional, so the verb that follows it typically takes the shortened jussive mood.

29.meaning: He sends astray / lets go astray — to cause someone to lose the way, or to leave them straying from the right path.
29.grammar: A present-tense causative verb in the jussive (apocopate) form (note the unvowelled ending and the unmerged doubled letter, which the jussive mood forces apart). The yu- prefix marks a single masculine doer ('he') of a causative action ('he causes to stray').
29.root: ض-ل-ل (ḍ-l-l) — to stray, go astray, err

30.meaning: So never / then never — a connector 'so/then' joined to an emphatic particle of negation that denies a future action absolutely: 'will never (at all)'.
30.grammar: 'fa-' is a connector meaning 'so/then', linking to what precedes. 'lan' negates a following present-tense verb and casts it into the future with emphatic force ('will never'); it also puts that verb into the subjunctive, which shows up as a final '-a' on the verb.

31.meaning: A second-person present verb: 'you find / you come upon.' It denotes discovering or encountering something, whether by searching or by chance.
31.grammar: The ta- prefix marks a second-person masculine singular subject ('you'). The final -a vowel is the subjunctive, the shape used after governing particles (such as 'never' or 'that'), often projecting the action into the future.
31.root: و-ج-د (w-j-d) — to find, to come upon

32.meaning: For him / to him / belonging to him. A small preposition meaning 'to/for' joined to the pronoun 'him', expressing possession, benefit, or direction toward him.
32.grammar: A preposition 'li-' ('to/for') fused with the attached pronoun 'him'. The pronoun 'him' stays the same; it is the preposition that changes, its vowel shifting from -i (li-) to -a (la-) when an attached pronoun follows it directly. The whole unit commonly conveys possession or that something is for someone's benefit.

33.meaning: A guardian, protector, ally, or close supporter — one who is near and takes charge of another's affairs. Waliyy carries the sense of nearness combined with care, authority, and friendship.
33.grammar: An indefinite noun ('a protector'). The -an ending (tanwīn fatḥa) is the accusative case: it commonly marks the word as a direct object of a verb, or as a predicate/complement after certain verbs of 'making' or 'becoming'.

34.meaning: "a guide, a director" — one who points out the right way and sets another on a sound course; a source of right direction.

parts.en: guide / director to the right way

34.grammar: An active participle ("one who guides") on the causative pattern, with the -an ending: this "tanwīn" of -a marks the indefinite accusative ("a/an …"), commonly used for a direct object or a specifying complement.
34.root: ر-ش-د (r-sh-d) — right guidance, sound judgment, maturity

1.meaning: "and you reckon/suppose them" — to think or assume something to be the case, to form a judgment that may or may not match reality.
1.grammar: A present-tense verb, second-person masculine singular: the ta- prefix means "you (one man)." The final -u vowel marks the indicative mood (a plain, ongoing statement). The attached -hum is an object pronoun, "them," referring to a group of males.
1.root: ح-س-ب (ḥ-s-b) — to reckon, count, suppose, calculate

2.meaning: "awake, wakeful" — being roused and alert, with eyes open, not sleeping.
2.grammar: A plural noun/adjective ("awake ones") with the -an ending: this "tanwīn" of -a marks the indefinite accusative ("a/an …"), often used for the complement that describes the state of something (a predicate or circumstantial description).
2.root: ي-ق-ظ (y-q-ẓ) — wakefulness, being alert and awake

3.meaning: 'And they.' The opening 'and' joined to the standalone subject pronoun 'they' (a group of males). A standalone pronoun like this typically begins or emphasizes a statement about its referent.
3.grammar: The conjunction wa ('and') with the detached subject pronoun hum ('they,' masculine plural). As an independent (not attached) pronoun, it serves as the subject of a clause and often lends emphasis to the ones spoken about.

4.meaning: "asleep / in a state of sleep" — the condition of lying down at rest in slumber. As a verbal noun it names the act/state of sleeping itself, and is used to describe people as being asleep.
4.grammar: A verbal noun (maṣdar) on the fuʿūl pattern from the verb "to sleep / lie down," denoting the act or state of sleeping. It carries the -un ending: this "tanwīn" of -u marks the indefinite nominative ("… are/is"), the case typically used for the subject of a sentence or a predicate describing it (here describing people as being asleep).
4.root: ر-ق-د (r-q-d) — to lie down, sleep, be at rest

5.meaning: "and We turn them over / We keep turning them" — to flip and rotate something from side to side, changing its position repeatedly.
5.grammar: A present-tense verb in the first-person plural: the nu- prefix means "we." It is built on the intensive/repetitive pattern (Form II), suggesting turning again and again. The final -u marks the indicative mood; the attached -hum is an object pronoun, "them."
5.root: ق-ل-ب (q-l-b) — to turn, overturn, flip; the heart

6.meaning: Possessor of, the one having, or the feminine 'that which has'. A feminine word meaning 'owner of' or 'characterized by', used to attach a quality or relationship to something (e.g. 'that which is between', i.e. the state of mutual relations).
6.grammar: A feminine noun of relation meaning 'possessor/owner of', placed before another noun to ascribe it. The -a ending is accusative: it commonly marks the object of a verb or otherwise the noun governed within the sentence.
6.root: — (functions as a noun of possession; no standard triliteral root).

7.meaning: "the right (side/hand)" — the right-hand direction, often carrying overtones of strength, good fortune, and honor.
7.grammar: A definite noun ("the …" via al-) carrying the -i (genitive) ending, which typically marks it as following a preposition or as linked to a preceding noun ("… of the right").
7.root: ي-م-ن (y-m-n) — the right side; good fortune, blessing

8.meaning: "and toward / and the side of" — "dhāt" literally means "possessor/owner of" and is commonly used to mean "the side of" or "that which belongs to."
8.grammar: A feminine noun meaning "possessor/side of," carrying the -a (accusative) ending. The accusative here typically functions adverbially — indicating direction or location ("toward / on the side of …") — and it links to a following noun in possession ("the side of …").
8.root: ذ-و-ي (dh-w-y) — the same root underlying "dhū" (possessor of); to possess, belong to

9.meaning: "the left (side/hand)" — the left-hand direction; also "the north" in some usages.
9.grammar: A definite noun ("the …" via al-, here assimilated to the following sh-) with the -i (genitive) ending, which typically marks it as following a preposition or as linked to a preceding noun ("… of the left").
9.root: ش-م-ل (sh-m-l) — the left side; the north; to encompass

10.meaning: "and their dog" — a dog, the familiar domestic animal, belonging to them.
10.grammar: A noun carrying the -u (nominative) ending, the case typically used for the subject of a sentence or the topic being described. The attached -hum is a possessive pronoun, "their," referring to a group of males.
10.root: ك-ل-ب (k-l-b) — a dog; to be voracious or seized

11.meaning: "stretching out, spreading wide" — one who extends or lays something out flat and open.
11.grammar: An active participle ("one who stretches/spreads") with the -un ending: this "tanwīn" of -u marks the indefinite nominative ("a … is/are"), the case typically used for the subject or a predicate describing it. As a participle it names the one performing the action.
11.root: ب-س-ط (b-s-ṭ) — to spread out, extend, stretch, make ample

12.meaning: "his two forearms / two forelegs" — the pair of arms (or, of an animal, the front legs) from elbow to hand.
12.grammar: A dual noun ("two …") in the accusative/genitive form, shown by the -ay ending which marks exactly two of something in the non-nominative case (often a direct object or following a possessor). The attached -hi is a possessive pronoun, "his."
12.root: ذ-ر-ع (dh-r-ʿ) — the forearm; a cubit; to measure by the arm

13.meaning: "at the threshold / the entrance" — "waṣīd" denotes the doorway, courtyard, or open ground just before an entrance.
13.grammar: The prefix bi- is a preposition meaning "at/by/with," and al- makes the noun definite ("the …"). The -i (genitive) ending is required because the noun follows the preposition bi-, which always puts what comes after it into the genitive case.
13.root: و-ص-د (w-ṣ-d) — a threshold, courtyard, or entrance; to shut firmly

14.meaning: If — a conditional particle introducing a hypothetical or contrary-to-fact supposition ('if it were the case that …'), typically implying the condition was not in fact met.
14.grammar: A conditional particle ('if'). It sets up a supposition, very often a contrary-to-fact one, whose result clause is then marked with an emphatic la- ('would have …'). The base form is law; its final vowel here appears as -i to ease pronunciation before a following consonant cluster.

15.meaning: A second-person masculine singular past-tense verb meaning 'you looked upon / you peered in / you became acquainted with' — to direct one's gaze toward something, often from above or into a place, so as to perceive or learn of it.

parts.en: looked upon / became acquainted (stem, form VIII)

15.grammar: Past (perfect) tense verb in the derived form VIII pattern (iftaʿala), where the doubled ṭ reflects the assimilation of the root's first letter into the infixed -t-. The suffix -ta marks a masculine singular 'you' as the one who did the action.
15.root: ط-ل-ع (ṭ-l-ʿ) — to rise/come into view, to look out over, to become informed of

16.meaning: A compound meaning 'upon them' or 'against them': the preposition ʿalā ('on, upon, over, against') joined to the plural pronoun 'them'. It conveys something resting on, being incumbent upon, or weighing against a group.
16.grammar: ʿalā shifts to the form ʿalay- before a pronoun. The suffix -him is the attached pronominal suffix for a masculine plural group ('them'); after a preposition it carries genitive/prepositional force, and the -i- vowel reflects its position after this preposition. Together they signal a relationship of something being over, upon, or burdensome to that group.
16.root: — (preposition with attached pronoun; no triliteral root)

17.meaning: A verb meaning 'you would have turned away / turned your back and fled' — to wheel around and depart, here introduced by the answer-particle lām that opens the result of a hypothetical condition.

parts.en: would surely have… (apodotic lām, answer of the condition)

17.grammar: The prefixed la- is the apodotic lām (lām al-jawāb), the marker that introduces the answer-clause of a hypothetical condition ('had it been so, you would surely have…'); it carries emphatic force but is syntactically the response-particle, not a free-standing oath or emphasis particle. The verb is past tense in form II (faʿʿala), seen in the doubled l. The suffix -ta marks a masculine singular 'you' as the doer.
17.root: و-ل-ي (w-l-y) — to turn, to be near, to take charge; in form II, to turn away/turn one's back

18.meaning: From them / among them — the preposition min ('from, out of, part of') joined to the pronoun 'them' (a group of males or a mixed group).
18.grammar: The preposition min ('from / among / part of') with the attached third-person masculine plural pronoun -hum ('them'). Pronouns after a preposition are in the genitive; the combination expresses origin, partition ('some of them'), or belonging to that group.

19.meaning: A noun meaning 'flight / fleeing / running away' — the act of escaping or bolting from something feared.
19.grammar: A verbal noun (maṣdar). The -an ending is the accusative case with nunation (tanwīn), marking it indefinite ('a flight'); the accusative often functions to specify manner or purpose ('in flight', 'as a fleeing').
19.root: ف-ر-ر (f-r-r) — to flee, to run away, to escape

20.meaning: A verb meaning 'and you would surely have been filled / brimmed over' — to be packed or saturated with something, here introduced by a connector and the answer-particle of a hypothetical condition.

parts.en: would surely have… (apodotic lām, answer of the condition)

20.grammar: Begins with the connector wa- (written as a geminated wāw, وَّ, because of assimilation with the preceding word) and the apodotic lām la- introducing the answer-clause of a hypothetical condition ('…you would surely have been filled'). The verb is past tense in the passive voice (the vowel pattern mu-li- signals 'was/were done to'), so the subject receives the action rather than performing it. The suffix -ta marks a masculine singular 'you' as the one filled.
20.root: م-ل-أ (m-l-ʾ) — to fill, to become full

21.meaning: From them / among them — the preposition min ('from, out of, part of') joined to the pronoun 'them' (a group of males or a mixed group).
21.grammar: The preposition min ('from / among / part of') with the attached third-person masculine plural pronoun -hum ('them'). Pronouns after a preposition are in the genitive; the combination expresses origin, partition ('some of them'), or belonging to that group.

22.meaning: A noun meaning 'terror / dread / fright' — overwhelming fear that strikes the heart.
22.grammar: A noun. The -an ending is the accusative case with nunation (indefinite). The accusative here typically functions as a specifier of content or respect ('filled WITH terror'), clarifying with what something is filled.
22.root: ر-ع-ب (r-ʿ-b) — to terrify, to fill with dread

1.meaning: 'And likewise / and in the same way / and thus' — a connective phrase pointing back to a manner just mentioned and saying 'in that very way…'. Built from 'and' + 'like' + 'that'.
1.grammar: 'wa' is 'and'; the prefix ka- means 'like/as'; 'dhālika' is the demonstrative 'that' (pointing to something distant or already mentioned). Because ka- acts like a preposition, the word after it stands in the genitive, though the demonstrative 'dhālika' keeps a fixed form and shows no visible case change. The whole means 'and just like that / and thus'.

2.meaning: A past-tense statement meaning 'We raised them up / roused them / sent them forth' — the verb baʿatha covers awakening from sleep, raising the dead, and dispatching someone for a purpose.
2.grammar: A completed (past-tense) verb. The -nā ending is the attached subject pronoun 'we' (the majestic plural of Allah); the final -hum is the attached object pronoun 'them' (a group of males). So the form packs subject and object into one word: 'We raised-them.'
2.root: ب-ع-ث (b-ʿ-th) — to raise up, rouse, awaken, send forth

3.meaning: A verb meaning 'so that they may question one another / ask each other' — mutual inquiry back and forth among a group, prefixed with a particle of purpose ('in order that').

parts.en: so that / in order that (particle of purpose)

3.grammar: The prefix li- ('so that') expresses purpose and puts the following verb in the subjunctive mood. The verb is present-tense form VI (tafāʿala), the pattern of reciprocal/mutual action ('do to one another'). The ya-…-ū frame marks a masculine plural 'they' as the doers; the stem transliteration ends at -lu, with the plural ending supplied by the separate -ū suffix.
3.root: س-أ-ل (s-ʾ-l) — to ask, to question, to request

4.meaning: An adverb of place meaning 'between' or 'among', here joined to the attached pronoun 'them'; together it conveys 'between them / amongst them', signalling something situated in the midst of a group or shared among parties.
4.grammar: An adverb of place (ẓarf) ending in -a, the accusative marker typical of such adverbs, indicating a location or relationship. The attached suffix '-hum' is a possessive/object pronoun meaning 'them' (a group of males or a mixed group).
4.root: ب-ي-ن (b-y-n) — separation, distinction, what lies in the midst

5.meaning: 'He said' — to speak, utter, or declare; the basic verb for saying words aloud, from the root meaning speech and utterance.
5.grammar: Past tense. The base verb with a final -a marks a third-person masculine singular subject ('he') and completed action ('he said'). The middle root letter (w) appears as a long -ā- inside this hollow verb.
5.root: ق-و-ل (q-w-l) — saying, speech, uttering

6.meaning: 'a speaker / one who says' — a person who utters or says something; one engaged in the act of speaking.
6.grammar: An active participle ('one who says') functioning as a noun. The ending -un (nominative vowel plus nunation) marks it indefinite and nominative — the case typically used for the subject of a sentence ('a speaker').

7.meaning: 'Among them / from them / some of them' — the preposition 'min' ('from, of, among') joined to the attached pronoun 'hum' ('them').
7.grammar: The preposition 'min' ('from / of / among') with the attached pronoun 'hum' ('them'), referring to a masculine plural group. Together they often express 'part of them' or 'some among them'.

8.meaning: How many / how much — a particle expressing a large or questioned quantity. It can ask "how many?" or exclaim "how many a…!" to stress abundance.
8.grammar: A quantity word used either to ask about a number ("how many?") or to declare a great number ("how many a…!"). It has no case ending; the noun it counts normally follows it in the singular.

9.meaning: A verb meaning 'you (all) tarried / remained / stayed' — to linger or abide in a place for a span of time.

parts.en: remained / stayed (stem; all three root letters)

9.grammar: A past (perfect) tense verb. The opening lām is the first radical of the root ل-ب-ث (not a separable particle), so the bare stem is labith- with no prefix. The suffix -tum marks a masculine plural 'you (all)' as those who remained.
9.root: ل-ب-ث (l-b-th) — to tarry, to stay, to remain for a time

10.meaning: 'They said' — a group uttered or stated something. Past-tense speech attributed to a plural subject.
10.grammar: A past-tense verb. The -ū ending marks a third-person masculine plural subject, 'they (said)'. It states a completed act of speaking in the past.
10.root: ق-و-ل (q-w-l) — saying, speech, utterance

11.meaning: A verb meaning 'we tarried / remained / stayed' — to linger or abide in a place for a span of time.

parts.en: remained / stayed (stem; all three root letters)

11.grammar: A past (perfect) tense verb. The opening lām is the first radical of the root ل-ب-ث (not a separable particle), so the bare stem is labith- with no prefix. The suffix -nā marks a first-person plural 'we' as those who remained.
11.root: ل-ب-ث (l-b-th) — to tarry, to stay, to remain for a time

12.meaning: A day; a defined stretch of time. Often used for a momentous appointed day such as a day of judgement or reckoning.
12.grammar: A singular masculine noun, indefinite ('a day'). The -an ending (tanwīn fatḥa) is the indefinite accusative case, which typically marks the object of a verb or a noun otherwise governed in the accusative.
12.root: ي-و-م (y-w-m) — day, time-period

13.meaning: Or — a particle offering an alternative or another option, linking two possibilities ('this… or that…'). It can also introduce an approximation or a different case.
13.grammar: A fixed connecting particle (a conjunction) with no case ending. It joins two words or clauses to present an alternative between them.

14.meaning: a part of / some of / a portion of — a noun denoting a piece or fraction of a larger whole (in the accusative form).
14.grammar: A noun meaning 'part' or 'some'. The final -a ending is accusative, marking it as a direct object or, with a measure of time, an adverbial span. It is normally followed by a noun in the genitive ('part of …').
14.root: ب-ع-ض (b-ʿ-ḍ) — a part, a portion, some

15.meaning: a day — a day, the basic unit of daytime or a twenty-four-hour span; figuratively a time or occasion.
15.grammar: A singular masculine noun. The final -in ending marks the genitive case together with the indefinite 'a/an'. The genitive is the case used after prepositions or to link this noun to a preceding word ('… of a day').
15.root: ي-و-م (y-w-m) — a day, a span of time

16.meaning: 'They said' — a group uttered or stated something. Past-tense speech attributed to a plural subject.
16.grammar: A past-tense verb. The -ū ending marks a third-person masculine plural subject, 'they (said)'. It states a completed act of speaking in the past.
16.root: ق-و-ل (q-w-l) — saying, speech, utterance

17.meaning: Your (plural) Lord — 'Rabb' means the Master, Owner, Sustainer, and Nurturer who creates, provides for, and brings a thing to its completion. It combines lordship with loving upbringing and care.
17.grammar: A noun with an attached possessive pronoun. The suffix '-kum' means 'your' (plural possessor). The '-u' on 'rabbu' before the suffix is the nominative case, marking the word as a subject or as a predicate standing on its own.
17.root: ر-ب-ب (r-b-b) — to nurture, master, sustain, own

18.meaning: 'I know' — a present-tense verb of knowing: to have certain knowledge or awareness of something.
18.grammar: A present/future (Form I) verb, first-person singular ('I'), marked by the prefix a-. This a- is the first-person agreement marker built into the conjugation, not a free-standing pronoun. The final -u marks the indicative — a plain statement of ongoing or habitual knowing.

19.meaning: A phrase meaning 'in/with that which' or 'in what' — combining the sense of 'by means of' or 'concerning' with an unspecified thing ('whatever it may be').
19.grammar: The preposition bi ('in, with, by means of, concerning') attached to the relative/indefinite pronoun mā ('what, that which'). Both elements are invariable, so the phrase carries no case ending. A word governed by the preposition bi is understood to be in the genitive relationship.
19.root: — (particle + relative pronoun)

20.meaning: A verb meaning 'you (all) tarried / remained / stayed' — to linger or abide in a place for a span of time.

parts.en: remained / stayed (stem; all three root letters)

20.grammar: A past (perfect) tense verb. The opening lām is the first radical of the root ل-ب-ث (not a separable particle), so the bare stem is labith- with no prefix. The suffix -tum marks a masculine plural 'you (all)' as those who remained.
20.root: ل-ب-ث (l-b-th) — to tarry, to stay, to remain for a time

21.meaning: So/then send forth, dispatch, or raise up — a command to a plural audience to send someone or rouse something into action.
21.grammar: A Form I plural imperative, 'send forth!' The initial alif is hamzat al-waṣl (a connecting alif dropped after the preceding fa-). The -ū ending marks the command as given to a male/mixed plural; the trailing alif is a silent orthographic alif (alif al-fāriqah) written after plural -ū. The fa- prefix means 'so/then,' linking the command to what precedes as a consequence.
21.root: ب-ع-ث (b-ʿ-th) — to send, dispatch, raise up, resurrect

22.meaning: A phrase meaning 'one of you / any one of you' — a single individual singled out from a group of addressees.
22.grammar: A noun ('one') in a possessive construction (iḍāfa) with the attached pronoun -kum ('your / of you', masculine plural). The -a ending on the noun is the accusative case, the case typically taken by the object of a verb. Because the pronoun completes the construction, the noun shows no nunation.

23.meaning: A phrase meaning 'with your silver / your silver coin(s)' — minted or worked silver used as money, joined to a preposition 'with' and 'your'.
23.grammar: The preposition bi- ('with, by means of') governs the following noun, which therefore takes the genitive -i ending. The noun is also in a possessive construction with -kum ('your', masculine plural). The genitive -i is the case regularly required after a preposition.
23.root: و-ر-ق (w-r-q) — leaf/foliage; by extension, silver and silver coinage

24.meaning: Feminine singular demonstrative pronoun, 'this (one)' — pointing to a single nearby thing that is grammatically feminine.
24.grammar: A demonstrative ('this') for a single feminine thing close at hand, contrasting with the masculine 'hādhā.' Demonstratives in Arabic do not change for grammatical case; the form stays fixed whether subject, object, or after a preposition.

25.meaning: 'To / toward / up to' — a preposition marking the endpoint, goal, or limit of an action or motion: the direction something moves toward or the boundary at which it stops.
25.grammar: An invariable preposition. It has no case ending of its own but puts the noun that follows it into the genitive ('of / to' state). It indicates direction toward, or the terminal limit of, something.

26.meaning: The city; a settled town, the definite 'the city'.
26.grammar: A definite noun with 'al-' ('the'). The -at- is the feminine ending (tāʾ marbūṭa), and the final -i is the genitive case, used after a preposition or to link to a preceding noun ('… of the city').

27.meaning: A verb meaning 'then let him look / let him observe' — a command issued in the third person ('let him…') directing someone to look at or consider something.
27.grammar: The connector fa- ('then, so') is followed by the imperative lām (l-), which turns a present-tense verb into a third-person command ('let him…'). The ya- prefix marks 'he', and the bare ending without a final vowel (jussive mood) is what the command lām requires.
27.root: ن-ظ-ر (n-ẓ-r) — to look, to see, to consider

28.meaning: A vocative word used in addressing people, equivalent to 'O...!' It is part of the standard formula for calling out to someone, drawing their attention before an address.
28.grammar: A vocative particle-complex used to call out ('O...'). It introduces the one being addressed and is typically followed by the noun naming them. It is a fixed address form rather than an inflected noun expressing case.

29.meaning: An elative/superlative adjective meaning 'purer / purest' or 'more wholesome' — that which is most cleansed, most growth-giving, or most blessed and good.
29.grammar: An elative adjective on the pattern afʿā (the comparative/superlative form, 'more/most …'). Built from a weak-final root, it ends in a fixed long -ā (alif maqṣūra) and does not change for case. It conveys the highest or greater degree of purity/wholesomeness.
29.root: ز-ك-و (z-k-w) — to be pure, to grow, to be wholesome and blessed

30.meaning: A noun meaning 'food / something to eat' — nourishment taken as a meal.
30.grammar: A noun. The -an ending is the accusative case with nunation (tanwīn), marking it indefinite ('some food'); the accusative is the case typically taken by the direct object of a verb or a specifier.
30.root: ط-ع-م (ṭ-ʿ-m) — to taste, to eat, to feed; food

31.meaning: A verb meaning 'then let him bring to you' — a third-person command ('let him…') to come bearing or delivering something to a group.
31.grammar: The connector fa- ('then') plus the imperative lām (l-) form a third-person command ('let him…'). The ya- prefix marks 'he', the verb is in the jussive mood required by the command lām (hence the shortened stem), and the attached -kum is the object 'you (all)' — together 'let him come/bring to you'.
31.root: أ-ت-ي (ʾ-t-y) — to come, to arrive; to bring

32.meaning: A phrase meaning 'with provision / with sustenance' — that which is provided for one's livelihood (food, goods, or means), joined to a preposition 'with'.
32.grammar: The preposition bi- ('with') governs the following noun, which takes the genitive case. The -in ending is genitive with nunation (tanwīn), marking the noun indefinite ('some provision'); the genitive is the case regularly required after a preposition.
32.root: ر-ز-ق (r-z-q) — to provide, to sustain; provision granted by Allah

33.meaning: A prepositional phrase, 'from him/it' — indicating origin or source, that something proceeds out of him/it.
33.grammar: The preposition min ('from') with the attached pronoun -hu ('him/it', third-person masculine singular). As the object of a preposition the pronoun stands in the genitive; the combination indicates source or origin.

34.meaning: A verb meaning 'and let him be gentle / subtle / discreet' — a third-person command ('let him…') to act with tact, kindness, and care so as to avoid notice or harm.
34.grammar: The connector wa- ('and') plus the imperative lām (l-) form a third-person command ('let him…'). The verb is present-tense form V (tafaʿʿala), a pattern often reflexive/intensive ('make oneself gentle, take care'). The ya- prefix marks 'he', and the bare ending without a final vowel (jussive) is what the command lām requires.
34.root: ل-ط-ف (l-ṭ-f) — to be gentle, subtle, kind, delicate

35.meaning: And not / but not — a connective 'and' joined to a negating particle that rules out or forbids what follows.
35.grammar: 'wa' is 'and'. 'lā' is a negating particle; placed before a verb of command it expresses prohibition ('do not ...'), and before other verbs/nouns it expresses negation ('not ...'). It carries no case ending.

36.meaning: A verb meaning 'let him (not) make aware / let him (not) cause to notice' — to give someone awareness or notice of something, here carrying a heavy emphatic ending ('let him by no means make aware').

parts.en: make aware / cause to perceive (stem, form IV)

36.grammar: A present-tense verb in the causative form IV (afʿala, 'to make someone perceive'). The yu- prefix marks 'he'. The ending -nna is the heavy nūn of emphasis, which strongly stresses the verb and is characteristic of forceful commands and prohibitions ('by no means let him…').
36.root: ش-ع-ر (sh-ʿ-r) — to perceive, to be aware, to sense

37.meaning: A preposition 'bi' ('with / by / in / for') joined to the attached pronoun 'you all', yielding 'with you' or 'for you (plural)'. The exact shade — attachment, instrument, or benefit — depends on the verb it accompanies.
37.grammar: A preposition plus an attached pronoun. 'bi' is a versatile preposition (with, by, in, for), and -kum is the genitive/object pronoun 'you all' (masculine plural). Pronouns following a preposition always take this attached (genitive) form.

38.meaning: Anyone / a single one: 'one' used to mean a sole individual, especially in negative or conditional contexts ('not anyone', 'any single person').
38.grammar: A noun meaning 'one / a single one', frequently used for 'anyone' when paired with a negation. The final -an (nunation) marks it as indefinite and in the accusative case, the case typically used for a verb's object.

1.meaning: 'Indeed they' — the emphatic particle 'inna' ('truly, indeed') joined to the pronoun 'them/they', strongly affirming a statement about a group.
1.grammar: The emphatic particle inna ('indeed / truly'), which strengthens and affirms a sentence, with the attached pronoun -hum ('they'). Inna places its attached noun or pronoun in the accusative, so -hum here functions as 'they' serving as the subject of the emphasized statement ('indeed they...').

2.meaning: The conditional particle 'in', meaning 'if'. It introduces a hypothetical or supposed condition, setting up a consequence that follows ('if … then …').
2.grammar: 'in' is an indeclinable conditional particle; it carries no case or tense ending of its own. It marks the clause after it as a supposition and leads the listener to expect a result clause.

3.meaning: '(That) they prevail / gain the upper hand / become dominant' — a present/future verb whose root sense is to appear or come out on top; in this form it means to overcome, gain mastery over, or become dominant over an opponent. It refers to a group of males.
3.grammar: A present-tense verb with the ya- prefix marking a masculine subject; the plural ending here is -ū (a group of males), and the dropped final -na (compared with the full -ūna) shows the verb is in the subjunctive/jussive mood — the form used after particles of purpose, negation, or condition, rather than a plain factual statement.
3.root: ظ-ه-ر (ẓ-h-r) — to appear, become manifest, prevail

4.meaning: 'Upon you (all)' — the preposition 'upon/on/over' joined to the plural 'you,' indicating something resting on or directed at a group.
4.grammar: The preposition 'ʿalā' ('upon/on/over') in its joined form 'ʿalay-' plus the attached pronoun '-kum' ('you all,' masculine plural). It marks the group as the recipients or target of whatever is laid 'upon' them.

5.meaning: A verb meaning 'they stone you' or 'they will stone you' — to pelt or kill someone with stones, with an attached object 'you (all)'.
5.grammar: A present-tense verb. The ya-…-ū frame marks a masculine plural 'they' as the doers. The final nūn of the masculine-plural ending (-ūna) drops to -ū here because the object pronoun -kum is attached directly to the verb — a regular morphophonological rule of nūn elision before a suffixed pronoun, not a marker of mood. The attached -kum is the object 'you (all)'.
5.root: ر-ج-م (r-j-m) — to stone, to pelt with stones; to cast out

6.meaning: Or — a particle offering an alternative or another option, linking two possibilities ('this… or that…'). It can also introduce an approximation or a different case.
6.grammar: A fixed connecting particle (a conjunction) with no case ending. It joins two words or clauses to present an alternative between them.

7.meaning: A verb meaning 'they bring you back / return you / make you revert' — to cause someone to go back into a former state or place, with an attached object 'you (all)'.
7.grammar: A present-tense verb in the causative form IV (afʿala, 'to make return'); the yu- prefix marks 'he/they' in this pattern. The …-ū frame marks a masculine plural 'they'. The final nūn of the plural ending (-ūna) drops to -ū because the object pronoun -kum is attached directly to the verb — a regular morphophonological rule of nūn elision before a suffixed pronoun, not a marker of mood. The attached -kum is the object 'you (all)'.
7.root: ع-و-د (ʿ-w-d) — to return, to come back, to revert

8.meaning: A preposition meaning 'in,' 'within,' or 'inside.' It locates something inside a place, a time, a state, or a matter — physically or figuratively (e.g. 'in' a condition or 'concerning' a matter).
8.grammar: A preposition. It is invariable (it does not change form) and places the following noun into the genitive case, indicating containment or location 'in / within' something.

9.meaning: A phrase meaning 'their creed / their religion / their way' — the body of belief and religious practice followed by a community, joined to 'their'.
9.grammar: A noun ('creed, religion') in a possessive construction (iḍāfa) with the attached pronoun -him ('their', masculine plural). The -i ending is the genitive case; here it appears because the noun is bound to a following possessor, and the t (tāʾ marbūṭa) is pronounced in this linkage.
9.root: م-ل-ل (m-l-l) — a religious community, creed, or way that is followed

10.meaning: A two-part expression combining 'and' with the particle of emphatic future negation. The core particle 'lan' negates a coming action with finality: 'will never / shall not (ever).' It denies that something will happen in the future, often with a tone of absolute impossibility.
10.grammar: A conjunction 'wa' ('and') joined to the negating particle 'lan'. 'Lan' governs a following present-tense verb, putting it into the subjunctive mood and turning its meaning into an emphatic denial of the future: 'it will never happen.'

11.meaning: A verb meaning 'you (all) succeed / prosper / attain salvation' — to achieve lasting well-being and triumph, especially the ultimate success of the soul.
11.grammar: A present-tense verb in form IV (afʿala); the tu- prefix marks second-person 'you'. The …-ū frame marks a masculine plural 'you (all)'. The dropped final nūn (-ū not -ūna) shows the subjunctive/jussive mood, typical after particles of purpose, negation, or condition.
11.root: ف-ل-ح (f-l-ḥ) — to thrive, to prosper, to succeed; original sense of cleaving/tilling soil, hence to reap reward

12.meaning: In that case / then — a response particle signaling that what follows is the consequence of a just-stated condition or supposition ('if so, then…').
12.grammar: A response/consequence particle, not a noun or verb. The -an ending is a fixed part of the word (written with a final alif), not a live grammatical case. It introduces the result side of a hypothetical ('then you would…').

13.meaning: An adverb meaning 'ever / forever / at any time' — used to stress that something will never (or always) be the case throughout all time, especially with a negative to mean 'never, not ever'.
13.grammar: A noun used adverbially. The ending -an is the indefinite accusative, the form regularly used to turn a word into an adverb of time ('… ever / forever'); the -n (nunation) marks it as indefinite. Paired with a negation it strengthens it to 'never, not ever'.
13.root: ء-ب-د (ʾ-b-d) — endless duration, eternity, perpetuity

1.meaning: 'And likewise / and in the same way / and thus' — a connective phrase pointing back to a manner just mentioned and saying 'in that very way…'. Built from 'and' + 'like' + 'that'.
1.grammar: 'wa' is 'and'; the prefix ka- means 'like/as'; 'dhālika' is the demonstrative 'that' (pointing to something distant or already mentioned). Because ka- acts like a preposition, the word after it stands in the genitive, though the demonstrative 'dhālika' keeps a fixed form and shows no visible case change. The whole means 'and just like that / and thus'.

2.meaning: A verb meaning 'we caused (others) to come upon / we made known / we disclosed' — to bring something to light so that it is discovered or stumbled upon.
2.grammar: A past-tense verb in the causative form IV (afʿala, 'to make someone come upon / to disclose'), shown by the opening a- prefix. The suffix -nā marks a first-person plural 'we' as the doers.
2.root: ع-ث-ر (ʿ-th-r) — to stumble upon, to come across, to discover

3.meaning: A compound meaning 'upon them' or 'against them': the preposition ʿalā ('on, upon, over, against') joined to the plural pronoun 'them'. It conveys something resting on, being incumbent upon, or weighing against a group.
3.grammar: ʿalā shifts to the form ʿalay- before a pronoun. The suffix -him is the attached pronominal suffix for a masculine plural group ('them'); after a preposition it carries genitive/prepositional force, and the -i- vowel reflects its position after this preposition. Together they signal a relationship of something being over, upon, or burdensome to that group.
3.root: — (preposition with attached pronoun; no triliteral root)

4.meaning: A verb meaning 'so that they may know / come to know' — to gain knowledge or certainty of something, prefixed with a particle of purpose ('in order that').

parts.en: so that / in order that (particle of purpose)

4.grammar: The prefix li- ('so that') expresses purpose and puts the verb in the subjunctive mood (hence -ū with the final nūn dropped). The ya-…-ū frame marks a masculine plural 'they' as those who come to know.
4.root: ع-ل-م (ʿ-l-m) — to know, to be aware; knowledge

5.meaning: An emphatic particle meaning 'that' (as in 'I know that...') or 'indeed/surely.' It introduces a statement and gives it certainty and emphasis, presenting what follows as an established fact.
5.grammar: An emphatic particle that introduces a noun-clause ('that...'). It puts the following noun into the accusative case and lends the whole statement a sense of certainty and assertion. It typically comes after verbs of knowing, saying, or informing.

6.meaning: 'a promise / pledge' — a binding assurance of something to come; here as a noun naming the thing pledged or the act of pledging.
6.grammar: A verbal noun with the -a (accusative) ending, which typically marks it as a direct object or as an emphatic inner object reinforcing a verb of the same meaning ('a promise [truly promised]'). It names the act/content of promising.
6.root: و-ع-د (w-ʿ-d) — to promise, pledge, give an assurance

7.meaning: The proper name of the One God in Arabic: 'Allah' — the unique, absolute Deity, the sole object of worship, beside whom there is no other.
7.grammar: This is a proper name. The '-i' ending is the genitive case, the form a noun takes after a preposition or when linked to a preceding noun ('… of Allah', or 'besides Allah'). The leading 'al-' is fused into the name itself.

8.meaning: 'Truth, reality, a rightful due' — that which is firmly real, correct, and established; also a right or claim that is owed. As a descriptor it means 'true, real, well-founded.'
8.grammar: An indefinite noun. The -un ending (nominative with tanwīn, the 'n' sound) is the form a noun takes as the subject or as the completing word of a statement ('is true/real').
8.root: ح-ق-ق (ḥ-q-q) — truth, right, reality, what is due

9.meaning: 'And that …' — the conjunction 'and' joined to the particle anna, which introduces and emphasizes a statement, asserting a fact emphatically (roughly 'and indeed that …'), and grammatically governs the noun that follows it.
9.grammar: A conjunction wa ('and') prefixed to anna, an emphatic particle meaning 'that' (asserting a fact). Anna puts the following noun into the accusative case and typically links a clause to a preceding verb of saying, knowing, or perceiving.

10.meaning: A noun meaning 'the Hour' — most particularly the Last Hour, the appointed time of the world's end and the Resurrection; literally a portion of time, an hour, or a moment.
10.grammar: A definite noun with the article al- (its l assimilates into the following 'sun letter' s, hence the doubled s). The -a ending is the accusative case, the case typically taken by the direct object of a verb or by what follows certain particles.
10.root: س-و-ع (s-w-ʿ) — a span of time, an hour; the appointed Hour

11.meaning: A particle of negation, 'no' or 'not'. In one common usage it denies the existence of an entire category ('there is no … at all'); it also serves as a simple 'no' and can negate verbs in certain constructions. Its core function is to cancel or rule out what follows.
11.grammar: An indeclinable negating particle: it has no case, tense, or number and never changes shape. It works by governing the word after it — for instance driving a following indefinite noun to a bare form to express absolute negation ('there is no …').

12.meaning: Doubt, suspicion, disquieting uncertainty — the kind of wavering that unsettles the heart, stronger than a passing question. It names the state of not being at rest about whether something is true.
12.grammar: A masculine singular noun shown with an -a ending and no tanwin. This is the accusative (mansub) noun governed by the negating particle la — its ism — taking a bare form to express absolute negation, conveying that the whole category is ruled out ('there is no doubt whatsoever').
12.root: ر-ي-ب (r-y-b) — doubt, disquiet

13.meaning: A compound meaning 'in it' or 'within it' — the preposition 'in/inside' fused with a feminine singular pronoun referring to some feminine or grammatically-feminine thing (a place, a thing, etc.).
13.grammar: A preposition plus an attached pronoun. The base 'fī' means 'in/within'; the suffix '-hā' is the third-person feminine singular object pronoun ('it/her'). Attached pronouns after a preposition are always in the dependent (genitive-type) form, so this reads 'in it.'

14.meaning: A particle meaning 'when' or 'at the time that', used to point back to a past moment or event and introduce a recollection of something that occurred.
14.grammar: An indeclinable particle (it has no case ending and never changes form). It signals a point in past time, typically introducing a clause that recalls 'the time when' something happened.

15.meaning: To quarrel, dispute, or wrangle with one another — a reciprocal contending in which parties pull against each other, in the form 'they contend among themselves.'
15.grammar: A present-tense verb in the reciprocal pattern (Form VI), which adds the sense of 'doing something to one another.' The 'ya-' prefix marks the third-person masculine (its bare form is third-person masculine singular); the plural 'they' is supplied by the '-ūna' ending, which also signals the indicative mood (a plain statement, 'they dispute'), as opposed to a shortened subjunctive/jussive form.
15.root: ن-ز-ع (n-z-ʿ) — to pull out, snatch, contend

16.meaning: An adverb of place meaning 'between' or 'among', here joined to the attached pronoun 'them'; together it conveys 'between them / amongst them', signalling something situated in the midst of a group or shared among parties.
16.grammar: An adverb of place (ẓarf) ending in -a, the accusative marker typical of such adverbs, indicating a location or relationship. The attached suffix '-hum' is a possessive/object pronoun meaning 'them' (a group of males or a mixed group).
16.root: ب-ي-ن (b-y-n) — separation, distinction, what lies in the midst

17.meaning: Means "their affair, matter, command" — a thing decided upon, an order, or a state of affairs; joined to the marker for "their."
17.grammar: A noun bearing the attached pronoun -hum, "their" (a masculine plural group). The -a ending before the pronoun is the accusative case, which typically marks the word as the object of a verb.
17.root: أ-م-ر (ʾ-m-r) — to command; an affair, matter, order

18.meaning: '…so / then they said.' Combines the connector 'so/then' (showing result or sequence) with a past-tense verb of speaking, third person plural — a completed act of saying by a group.
18.grammar: A completed-action (past) verb prefixed with 'fa-' ('so/then'), which links it to what precedes as a result or next step. The '-ū' ending (with silent trailing alif) marks the subject as 'they' (masculine plural).

19.meaning: A command addressed to a group: 'Build!' or 'Construct!' — an order to erect or put up a structure.
19.grammar: An imperative (command) verb. The plural-command ending '-ū' addresses several men ('you all'), so it means 'build, you all.' The 'i-' at the front is a helping vowel that lets the word begin when the root would otherwise start with a cluster; the spelling 'ابۡنُوۡا' carries a silent 'alif' after the '-ū'.
19.root: ب-ن-ي (b-n-y) — to build, construct

20.meaning: A compound meaning 'upon them' or 'against them': the preposition ʿalā ('on, upon, over, against') joined to the plural pronoun 'them'. It conveys something resting on, being incumbent upon, or weighing against a group.
20.grammar: ʿalā shifts to the form ʿalay- before a pronoun. The suffix -him is the attached pronominal suffix for a masculine plural group ('them'); after a preposition it carries genitive/prepositional force, and the -i- vowel reflects its position after this preposition. Together they signal a relationship of something being over, upon, or burdensome to that group.
20.root: — (preposition with attached pronoun; no triliteral root)

21.meaning: A building, structure, or edifice — that which is built up; construction work or an erected mass.
21.grammar: A noun. The '-an' ending (with the double-vowel 'tanwīn' on an indefinite word) is the accusative case: it commonly marks the direct object of a verb ('built a structure') or the thing specified after a number or quantity. The indefiniteness ('a structure,' not 'the structure') comes from that same '-an' nunation.

22.meaning: 'Their Lord' — the noun 'Lord' (Master, Sustainer, Nurturer who owns, provides, and brings to maturity) joined to the pronoun 'their'.
22.grammar: A noun with a possessive pronoun. The -u vowel before -hum is the nominative ending, typically marking the word as the subject/doer. The suffix -hum means 'their', referring to a masculine plural group.
22.root: ر-ب-ب (r-b-b) — to be lord, master, to nurture and sustain

23.meaning: 'I know' — a present-tense verb of knowing: to have certain knowledge or awareness of something.
23.grammar: A present/future (Form I) verb, first-person singular ('I'), marked by the prefix a-. This a- is the first-person agreement marker built into the conjugation, not a free-standing pronoun. The final -u marks the indicative — a plain statement of ongoing or habitual knowing.

24.meaning: An expression meaning 'at them' or 'with them' — the preposition 'bi' (with, by, at) joined to the pronoun 'them' (a group). The exact shade ('at/by/with them') depends on the verb it accompanies.
24.grammar: A preposition (bi-, 'with/by/at') with the attached pronoun -him ('them,' for a group of males). The pronoun is in the genitive, the case always required after a preposition.

25.meaning: 'He said' — to speak, utter, or declare; the basic verb for saying words aloud, from the root meaning speech and utterance.
25.grammar: Past tense. The base verb with a final -a marks a third-person masculine singular subject ('he') and completed action ('he said'). The middle root letter (w) appears as a long -ā- inside this hollow verb.

26.meaning: 'Those who' — a relative pronoun for a group of masculine (or mixed) persons, introducing a clause that describes them: 'the ones who …'. It links a following statement back to the people it refers to.
26.grammar: A masculine plural relative pronoun. Although it ends in -ina, it is indeclinable — fixed in this one form for every grammatical position — and simply means 'those who'. It must be completed by a following clause that tells what those people do or are.

27.meaning: To overcome, prevail, gain the upper hand, or be victorious over something — in the completed sense 'they prevailed / they won out.'
27.grammar: A past-tense (completed-action) verb. The ending '-ū' (written with a silent trailing 'alif') marks a third-person masculine plural subject — 'they overcame / they prevailed.' The plain past stem indicates the action is viewed as finished.

28.meaning: A preposition meaning 'on, upon, over,' and by extension 'against' or 'incumbent upon.' It can mark something resting on top of, an obligation laid on someone, or being set over/above something.
28.grammar: An indeclinable preposition (its form never changes). It governs the following noun, putting it in the genitive case, and conveys location 'on/upon,' or figuratively duty or opposition ('against').

29.meaning: A compound: 'their affair' / 'their matter' / 'their command' — the word 'amr' (a matter, affair, command, or situation) joined to the pronoun 'their.'
29.grammar: A noun with an attached possessive pronoun. The '-i' before the pronoun is the genitive case, which appears when the word follows a preposition or is possessed/linked to another word ('… of …'). The suffix '-him' is 'their' (masculine plural); its vowel is 'i' (not '-hum') precisely because it follows the genitive '-i.'

30.meaning: An emphatic pledge: 'We shall most surely take/adopt' — to take for oneself, seize upon, or adopt something, stated with strong oath-like emphasis.
30.grammar: A present/future verb wrapped in double emphasis. The 'la-' prefix is an emphatic 'surely/indeed' (typically introducing the answer to an oath), and the heavy '-nna' suffix ('nūn of emphasis') reinforces it: 'we will definitely do this.' The 'na-' prefix means 'we.' The stem is Form VIII (an 'acquiring/taking-for-oneself' pattern), where the original root's first letter has assimilated into a doubled 'tt.'

31.meaning: A compound meaning 'upon them' or 'against them': the preposition ʿalā ('on, upon, over, against') joined to the plural pronoun 'them'. It conveys something resting on, being incumbent upon, or weighing against a group.
31.grammar: ʿalā shifts to the form ʿalay- before a pronoun. The suffix -him is the attached pronominal suffix for a masculine plural group ('them'); after a preposition it carries genitive/prepositional force, and the -i- vowel reflects its position after this preposition. Together they signal a relationship of something being over, upon, or burdensome to that group.
31.root: — (preposition with attached pronoun; no triliteral root)

32.meaning: A place of prostration; a mosque or place of worship — literally the spot where one bows down (prostrates) to worship.
32.grammar: A noun of place built on the 'ma-' pattern (a 'place where X happens'), so it denotes the location of prostration. The '-an' ending (indefinite 'tanwīn') is accusative, typically marking the direct object of a verb ('took/built a place of worship'). 'A mosque,' indefinite, comes from that nunation.
32.root: س-ج-د (s-j-d) — to prostrate, bow down in worship

1.meaning: A statement about the future: 'they will say' — the act of speaking/saying, marked as something that is going to happen.
1.grammar: A present-tense verb turned into the future by the prefixed particle 'sa-' ('will/shall'). The 'ya-' prefix marks the third-person masculine (its bare form is third-person masculine singular); the plural 'they' is supplied by the '-ūna' ending, which also marks the indicative mood (a plain assertion). Together: 'they will say.'

2.meaning: 'Three' — the cardinal number three. As a standalone noun it names the quantity itself.
2.grammar: A cardinal-number noun. The ending -un is nominative (the subject/predicate case) and indefinite, the final -n (tanwīn) marking it as indefinite ('three' standing on its own rather than 'the three').
2.root: ث-ل-ث (th-l-th) — three

3.meaning: A compound ordinal: 'the fourth of them' — the one who is fourth in a group, the position-four member among them.
3.grammar: An ordinal number ('fourth') in the active-participle pattern, with an attached pronoun. The '-u' ending is the nominative case, the default form for a subject or a predicate ('the fourth is …'). The suffix '-hum' is 'them/of them' (masculine plural), keeping its 'u' vowel because it follows the nominative '-u'; it links the ordinal to the group ('the fourth of them').

4.meaning: A compound: 'their dog' — the animal 'dog' joined to the possessive pronoun 'their.'
4.grammar: A noun with an attached possessive pronoun. The '-u' ending is the nominative case (the default form for a subject or predicate). The suffix '-hum' means 'their' (masculine plural); it keeps its 'u' vowel because it follows the nominative '-u.'

5.meaning: A verb meaning 'and they say / and they keep saying' — to utter or assert in speech. The structure presents an ongoing or repeated act of speaking by a group.
5.grammar: A present-tense (imperfect) verb joined by wa- ('and'). The ya-…-ūna frame marks the 3rd-person masculine plural ('they'); the full -ūna ending is the inseparable indicative-plural suffix, showing the verb is in its base (indicative) form and expressing an ongoing or habitual action.
5.root: ق-و-ل (q-w-l) — to say, speak, utter

6.meaning: The cardinal number 'five' (in its feminine-form shape used when counting masculine items).
6.grammar: A number-noun. The '-un' ending (indefinite 'tanwīn') is the nominative case, the default form used for a subject or a predicate ('they are five'). The '-at' (tied-tāʾ) is the feminine spelling that Arabic uses for the numbers 3–10 when the counted things are masculine.

7.meaning: A compound ordinal: 'the sixth of them' — the position-six member among a group.
7.grammar: An ordinal number ('sixth') in the active-participle pattern, with an attached pronoun. The '-u' ending is the nominative case (default for a subject or predicate). The suffix '-hum' is 'them/of them' (masculine plural), keeping its 'u' vowel after the nominative '-u'; it links the ordinal to the group ('the sixth of them').

8.meaning: A compound: 'their dog' — the animal 'dog' joined to the possessive pronoun 'their.'
8.grammar: A noun with an attached possessive pronoun. The '-u' ending is the nominative case (the default form for a subject or predicate). The suffix '-hum' means 'their' (masculine plural); it keeps its 'u' vowel because it follows the nominative '-u.'

9.meaning: Stoning; the casting of stones — and, by extension, conjecture or guessing 'thrown out' at random, as one hurls a stone without aim.
